Hi Irene — thanks for sending the form and sample. Welcome aboard. A few details to make the onboarding and first invoice smooth: 

Short answers up front: 
- Preferred: vendor portal upload (our portal validates PO, line items, and remit info).
- Acceptable fallback: email to ap@redwood.com for low-volume vendors, but invoices emailed are processed manually and can be delayed.
- SFTP/EDI: available for high-volume partners; we can enable if you expect >100 invoices/month or want automated pulls.

Mandatory invoice fields we require for invoice acceptance: 
- Redwood PO number (if the purchase was PO-backed) OR our contract reference (MSA + SOW number)
- Invoice date and invoice number (unique)
- Line-level descriptions with unit price and quantity (or subscription period per line)
- Total before tax, tax amount by jurisdiction, and total due
- Remit-to details (name and address) and preferred payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45)

I've attached a small sample CSV that mirrors the portal's accepted format (redwood-invoice-sample.csv). If you plan to send invoices by email, please include a single PDF and a flattened CSV of line items to speed OCR ingestion.

If you'd like to try the portal, I can send an account invite today. For SFTP, we'll need your IT contact so we can exchange keys — cc'd Karthik to advise on EDI onboarding cadence.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Operations / Finance

Mina — quick internal note and FYI to Irene.

Forwarding our standard guidance: portal-first, email fallback for low-volume vendors, SFTP reserved for EDI partners. A couple of clarifications for CloudSync specifically:
- Because CloudSync is a SaaS subscription vendor and we've got an MSA in flight, we can accept monthly consolidated invoices without a PO for recurring fees if the contract references are present on the invoice (please put MSA# on header).
- If they want AP automation later, we should coordinate an SFTP test window (we usually do one week of sample drops).
- Required for GL mapping: product code (if available) or clear service description + start/end dates.

I'll handle the SFTP onboarding checklist and coordinate with IT if they opt-in. Mina — if you send the portal invite, include the sample CSV and our vendor onboarding guide link.
